recognize_zh: 淋巴組織 H&E 呈多形性浸潤：小淋巴球、漿細胞、大量大型免疫母細胞，並可見分裂相與一個大型多核或雙核細胞，細胞大小呈連續光譜而非單一族群，是傳染性單核球增多症的組織學特徵。
features: Diffuse polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasma cells, and large immunoblasts
Numerous immunoblasts with vesicular nuclei and prominent central nucleoli
Mitotic figures and apoptotic debris present
Continuous spectrum of cell sizes without a monotonous sheet
describe_en: Sections of lymphoid tissue (lymph node or tonsil) show a diffuse, polymorphous infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, plasma cells, and many large immunoblasts with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli. Occasional large binucleate cells resembling Reed-Sternberg cells, mitotic figures, and apoptotic bodies are present. The cells form a continuous spectrum of maturation rather than a monomorphic population. Findings are consistent with florid immunoblastic proliferation of infectious mononucleosis; EBER in situ hybridization and serology help confirm, and immunohistochemistry helps exclude lymphoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL is a monotonous sheet of large cells with architectural effacement and light-chain restriction, unlike this polymorphous, polyclonal immunoblastic proliferation.
cHL has CD15+/CD30+/CD45- HRS cells in an inflammatory background, whereas IM immunoblasts are CD20+/CD45+ and form a continuum with plasma cells.
PTCL shows atypical medium-to-large T cells with aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR rearrangement, which IM lacks.
